newsitem.title: USA: Fluor, partner win $120 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Fluor, partner win $120 mln contract.

text.p: Fluor Corp's principal operating unit, Fluor Daniel Inc, and its joint partner SADE, an Argentine construction company, have won a construction contract valued at about $120 million.

The two companies will provide basic engineering, project management, engineering, procurement and contracting services for Cerro Vanguardia, a $237 million gold and silver mine and processing plant in Santa Cruz, Argentina.
The contract was awared by Cerro Vanguardia S.A., an Argentine company.

"This is Fluor Daniel's second major undertaking in Argentina, and we are extremely pleased to have been chosen to work on this project," said Phil Asherman, president of Fluor Daniel's Mining & Minerals operating company.
A 1996 feasibility study estimates mining reserves to be at 9.3 million tons, containing 2.7 million ounces of gold and 27.2 million ounces of silver.
Production is scheduled to begin in mid-1998 with full production levels being reached by year-end. Employment levels for operations will peak at about 300 people.
